name: Layered Voxel Rendering
definition: A real-time voxel rendering method that splits a 3D voxel scene into 2D image layers (slices) along the vertical axis, pre-shades the voxels within those layers, and renders the layers from bottom to top.
summary: Layered Voxel Rendering converts 3D voxels into pre-shaded 2D slices composited via 2D transformations, decoupling shading from rendering to enable real-time performance.
